text: クチバの　みなと　といえば　つりおやじは　げんき　かなー？

structure.jp: クチバの　みなと　といえば
つりおやじは　げんき　かなー？
structure.en: I wonder if the Fishing Guru is well?

patterns.name: 〜といえば
patterns.explanation: といえば after a noun means 'speaking of' it, used to bring up something it reminds you of. クチバの　みなと　といえば = 'speaking of Vermilion's harbor'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', a question asked half to yourself; it is stretched out here. げんき　かなー = 'I wonder if he's doing well'.
